identifier_namespaces.geometry_rule: Non-area delivery identifier; never convert the box identifier into a postcode or postcode polygon.
identifier_namespaces.public_data_rule: No subscriber names, private mailbox ownership or recipient records.

identifier_namespaces.geometry_rule: Source-linked entrance geometry only. Do not treat an entrance locator as a postal catchment or a verified building name.
identifier_namespaces.public_data_rule: A documented deployment in Dubai does not prove nationwide coverage. Unit identifiers are a separate, privacy-reviewed namespace.

identifier_namespaces.geometry_rule: Retain Onwani postal codes as their own scoped identifiers. Require explicit source geometry and assignment evidence before publishing areas or address links.
identifier_namespaces.public_data_rule: Do not substitute a PO Box number, Makani identifier, parcel number or fabricated zero code.

authority_model.rule: Postal, municipal address, entrance, parcel and building evidence remain independent. An official document or geometry alone is not an assignment dataset.

stages.definition: Identify operator and emirate-level addressing systems and unresolved source rights.
Review the namespace, authority, privacy and publication contract with source-backed negative tests.

A rights-cleared, editioned real dataset for an explicitly declared AE jurisdiction and identifier namespace reproduces published digest-pinned experimental context artifacts and passes namespace-aware AGID integration; documentation, synthetic fixtures and a no-postcode label do not satisfy this stage.
Independent holdout, coverage, exceptions, freshness and source-linked civic/building checks pass within the declared scope.
Repeated source refreshes, corrections and verified rollback operate under reviewed redistribution and privacy rules.

agid_integration.current_scope: Source registry and address-format metadata only; AE is not enabled as a generic country-only Postal Context runtime.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: Add an explicit namespace/jurisdiction contract before enabling a real AE runtime. Do not flatten PO Box, Onwani and Makani into a single numeric postcode parser.
agid_integration.agid_cell_rule: A coordinate cell is an independent spatial reference, not evidence of postal assignment or building identity.
